questions.question: On the price board's newest day for each hub, which hub had the highest day-ahead daily mean, and what was it in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: SPP North hub (spp:SPPNORTH_HUB) had the highest day-ahead daily mean on the price board's newest day: 51.72 USD/MWh (price_board_latest, derived table). The newest day is 2026-11-06, the local operating day, and the value is the board's day-ahead mean for that complete day. The next highest were CAISO TH_NP15_GEN-APND at 51.30 USD/MWh and ERCOT HB_WEST at 45.01 USD/MWh (price_board_latest). The ranking covers the 11 hubs the table returned, all dated 2026-11-06. MISO, NYISO and ISO-NE hubs did not appear in the table as read, so they are not in this comparison.

questions.question: What moved most on the price board: which hub's day-ahead daily mean changed most, in percent, on its newest day against the day before, and by how much?
questions.answer: ERCOT HB_WEST had the biggest percentage move in its day-ahead daily mean. It rose 132.19% (price_board_latest, derived) on its newest day, 2026-11-06 (local operating day), against the day before. The mean went from 19.39 USD/MWh on 2026-11-05 to 45.01 USD/MWh on 2026-11-06, a change of 25.63 USD/MWh (price_board_latest). The next largest moves were SPPNORTH_HUB at 82.96% and ERCOT HB_NORTH at 79.56%. The ranking covers 11 hubs: ERCOT, SPP and CAISO. The board's newest day is 2026-11-06, not today, and the table was last run 2026-11-05T23:44:58Z.

questions.question: Where is the spark spread widest on the price board (each hub's newest day, at the board's stated heat rate), and what is it in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The spark spread is widest at SPP North Hub (spp:SPPNORTH_HUB). It is 33.31 USD/MWh on the board's newest day, 2026-11-06 (price_board_spreads, derived). That is the day-ahead daily mean minus an assumed 7.0 MMBtu/MWh heat rate times Henry Hub, so the heat rate is an assumption. The next widest are CAISO TH_SP15_GEN-APND at 25.33 USD/MWh and ERCOT HB_HUBAVG at 22.23 USD/MWh, both on 2026-11-06. Only these three hubs have spark-spread rows on the board. Dates are the board's local operating days.

questions.question: On the price board, which hub's day-ahead price ran furthest from real time (day-ahead minus real time, either sign) on its newest day, and by how much in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: ERCOT's HB_WEST had the largest gap on the price board. Its day-ahead price was 16.44 USD/MWh above real time (price_board_latest, derived: da_minus_rt = 16.4397 USD/MWh) on its newest day, 2026-11-04 (a local operating day, dated 00:00Z). Of the 11 board hubs, the next largest gaps were ERCOT HB_SOUTH at 15.28 USD/MWh and ERCOT HB_HUBAVG at 14.77 USD/MWh. The largest negative gap was SPPNORTH_HUB at -9.02 USD/MWh on 2026-10-31, where real time was above day-ahead. Each hub is compared on its own newest day, and the SPP hubs' newest day is earlier than the others'.
